title: Autologous Chondrocyte Implantation (ACI / MACI) for Knee Cartilage Defects
description: Medicare coverage criteria for matrix-induced autologous chondrocyte implantation (MACI) of the femoral condyle or trochlea. Requires full-thickness focal chondral defect (Outerbridge Grade IV, size 1.5 to 10 cm2), failure of prior conservative or surgical microfracture, and absence of diffuse osteoarthritis.

criteria.name: Focal Chondral Defect Surface Area (1.5 to 10.0 cm2)
criteria.description: Documented full-thickness cartilage defect (Outerbridge Grade III or IV) measuring between 1.5 and 10.0 square centimeters on arthroscopy or MRI.
criteria.clinical_intent: Verify focal lesion area within FDA approved range
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Prior Debridement or Marrow Stimulation Failure
criteria.description: Documented prior trial and failure of conservative management or prior surgical debridement/microfracture >= 6 months prior.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm failure of initial surgical intervention
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Generalized Severe Tricompartmental Osteoarthritis Exclusion
criteria.description: Diffuse degenerative joint disease or severe osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence Grade 3 or 4) across multiple compartments.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude diffuse joint degeneration where arthroplasty is indicated
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

cms_reference.notes: No national (NCD) or local (LCD) coverage determination exists in the Medicare Coverage Database. Covered under Medicare reasonable and necessary standard.
cms_reference.authority: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A)
